metadata.question: Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Thailand boundary from FAO GAUL Level 0 (2015).
- Time: Compare Feb 2008 (2008-02-01 to 2008-03-01) vs Aug 2008 (2008-08-01 to 2008-09-01).
- Dataset: Primary = MODIS Burned Area monthly (MODIS/061/MCD64A1). Fallback = MODIS/006/MCD64A1 if needed.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use BurnDate>0 mask to detect burned pixels. Cloud masking not required for burned area product (already processed).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size == 0 for either month -> C1.
- If valid pixel count (unmasked) == 0 -> C2.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN -> C3.
- Else compare burned area (km²). If Aug > Feb -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0');
    let thFC = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Thailand'));
    let thSize = await thFC.size().getInfo();
    if (thSize === 0) {
      thFC = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'THAILAND'));
      thSize = await thFC.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (thSize === 0) {
      console.log('Thailand boundary not found.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const thailand = ee.Feature(thFC.first()).geometry();

    const periods = [
      { label: 'Feb 2008', start: '2008-02-01', end: '2008-03-01' },
      { label: 'Aug 2008', start: '2008-08-01', end: '2008-09-01' }
    ];

    async function monthStats(region, start, end) {
      // Try v6.1
      let datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MCD64A1';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select('BurnDate');
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // Fallback to v6.0
        datasetId = 'MODIS/006/MCD64A1';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(region)
          .select('BurnDate');
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          return { status: 'C1', datasetId, size };
        }
      }
      const img = ee.Image(col.first()).select('BurnDate');
      const validPix = await img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('BurnDate').getInfo();
      if (validPix === null || validPix === 0) return { status: 'C2', datasetId, size, validPix };

      const burn = img.gt(0);
      const burnedPix = await burn.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('BurnDate').getInfo();
      if (burnedPix === null) return { status: 'C3', datasetId, size, validPix };

      const burnedArea_m2 = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(burn).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('area').getInfo();
      if (burnedArea_m2 === null || isNaN(burnedArea_m2)) return { status: 'C3', datasetId, size, validPix, burnedPix };

      return { status: 'OK', datasetId, size, validPix, burnedPix, burnedArea_m2 };
    }

    const feb = await monthStats(thailand, periods[0].start, periods[0].end);
    const aug = await monthStats(thailand, periods[1].start, periods[1].end);

    // Handle error cases
    if (feb.status !== 'OK' || aug.status !== 'OK') {
      // Print concise diagnostics
      if (feb.status !== 'OK') {
        console.log(`${periods[0].label}: status=${feb.status}, images=${feb.size ?? 'NA'}, validPix=${feb.validPix ?? 'NA'}`);
        console.log(feb.status);
        return;
      }
      if (aug.status !== 'OK') {
        console.log(`${periods[1].label}: status=${aug.status}, images=${aug.size ?? 'NA'}, validPix=${aug.validPix ?? 'NA'}`);
        console.log(aug.status);
        return;
      }
    }

    // 3. Processing & Output
    const febArea_km2 = feb.burnedArea_m2 / 1e6;
    const augArea_km2 = aug.burnedArea_m2 / 1e6;

    console.log(`${periods[0].label} [${feb.datasetId}]: images=${feb.size}, validPix=${feb.validPix}, burnedPix=${feb.burnedPix}, burnedArea_km2=${febArea_km2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`${periods[1].label} [${aug.datasetId}]: images=${aug.size}, validPix=${aug.validPix}, burnedPix=${aug.burnedPix}, burnedArea_km2=${augArea_km2.toFixed(1)}`);

    const answer = (augArea_km2 > febArea_km2) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
